name: asyncio.library
runtimeDependencies: 68020 or later for the m68k API, with dos.library
WarpOS powerpc.library 15.0 or later for the PPC API
notes: Achim Stegemann's 19 June 2001 mixed 68k/WarpOS library and the in-archive readme exactly match the stock files. The 68k and WarpOS entry points share the same installed library.

SongPlayer enables USE_ASYNCIO in its shipped config. The EaglePlayer MPEG_Audio and MPEGAudio players, MiamiFtp and MUI GIFAnim.mcc also name asyncio.library; their existing packages own those consumers.
The Programs, Libs and Locale/Help/english parent drawers are shared. The installed OS AsyncWB and its BCWB icon are separate.
